objective: Improve state-conditioned incoming-weight learning through joint posterior geometry; no architecture, feature, target, or loss-head change.
family_source: Original cleanrl/plasticity/FAMILY.md in HEAD; current measurements in notes/per_unit.md and notes/cross_neuron.md.
hypothesis: Compressing precision and folding discarded correlation energy into its diagonal can assert certainty in unsupported directions. Compress covariance downdates instead: P = diag(D) - U U^T, retaining largest prior-whitened modes and restoring uncertainty in discarded directions. This may preserve acquisition and adaptation without destroying coordinated credit assignment.

derivation.prior: D <- D + Q; P = diag(D) - U U^T
derivation.observation: j = exact network output Jacobian; v = P j; s = R + j^T v; theta <- theta - v residual / s; U <- [U, v / sqrt(s)]
derivation.compression: V are top-r eigenvectors of U^T diag(D)^-1 U; U_new = U V. P_new - P_old = U(I - VV^T)U^T is PSD in exact arithmetic.
derivation.meaning: Current state enters every update through j(x). Joint covariance can give a unit credit even where its local Jacobian vanishes. This is network-coordinated plasticity, not an autonomous scalar gate.
derivation.risk: Restoring uncertainty can overfit noise or repeatedly relearn discarded directions. PSD preservation does not prove good learning, nonlinear posterior calibration, or global optimality. FP32 must be checked; do not clip away negative variances.

controls.network: Full covariance EKF, same initialization/prior/process/noise rule; approximation reference, not ground-truth Bayesian posterior for nonlinear weights.
controls.unit: Neuron-block covariance, same initialization and noise/process setting.
controls.diagonal: Exact diagonal projection after each covariance observation update.
controls.sketch_scalar_r64: Keeps sketch posterior conditioning but replaces mean-update direction by j times (j^T Pj)/(j^T j). Same instantaneous output leverage; erases directional preconditioning. Independent subsequent trajectories.
controls.capacity: All learners use identical 17-64-64-1 tanh network, 5377 parameters. Posterior state and compute explicitly differ.

selection.criterion: Independently minimize duration-weighted sustained clean-validation error for each arm. Save selection before evaluating stored checkpoints on untouched test examples. Report edge winners, all validation candidates, sustained/endpoint/phase test errors. No clean target affects updates.
selection.success: Primary must improve sustained clean test error against full covariance to establish a stronger learner, not merely beat Adam or run faster. Beating scalar control is required to credit joint geometry. Rank arms measure approximation curve, not post-hoc primary replacement.

execution.precision: CUDA float32 posterior with TF32 disabled, matching full-reference arithmetic policy. Compiled updates and CUDA graph recurrence, no eager/CPU fallback. Report compression execution mode and actual timings.
execution.autocull: No performance cull within these fixed 65536-observation diagnostic streams: the midpoint switch and final recovery are required endpoints. Stop on invalid numerical state; no automatic retries. Root TensorBoard logging required.

verification: Independent small dense Gaussian updates before compression; whitened mode choice; PSD covariance restoration; scalar leverage equality/directional difference; current-label causality and clean-target isolation; complete CUDA capture state restoration; correct sample and phase clocks; sustained-validation selection before test.
limits: One paired task seed; no independent-seed or PPO claim. Existing precision-sketch results use a different selection protocol and are not directly ranked against this experiment. No global-maximum guarantee.
